meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行;点击图标可以启动、停止或重启该服务。
howto.when: 仅限 macOS,并且需要先装好 Xcode Command Line Tools(swiftc);当你想给 NanoClaw 加菜单栏运行状态指示时使用。已安装过则会跳到验证步骤。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 会编译 Swift 程序并注册 launchd 服务

say.text: 重启菜单栏里的 NanoClaw 服务
say.note: 等同于点图标菜单里的 Restart

say.text: 卸载 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态栏
say.note: 按 REMOVE.md 的步骤卸载

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar bolt icon with a green or red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running. Click it to start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: macOS only, and requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc). If the status bar is already installed, the skill skips ahead to verification.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Compiles the Swift binary and loads a launchd agent

say_en.text: Restart the NanoClaw service from the menu bar
say_en.note: Same as the Restart item in the icon menu

say_en.text: Uninstall the NanoClaw menu bar status bar
